description: The close audit trail: one row per action on a period (approve, reject, close, lock, reopen, sign-off, trial balance). Append-only: written only by konsol.close.close_event, never changed, never deleted (konsol#305, #305-W2-1, #305-W2-6).

fields.label: Fiscal Period
fields.description: 0 = the whole year (Close Year, Lock Year, Reopen Year). Otherwise the period the action was on.

fields.label: Kind
fields.options:
approved
self_approved
rejected
approval_cancelled
period_closed
period_locked
period_reopened
year_closed
year_locked
year_reopened
signed_off
signoff_voided
signoff_rejected
tb_submitted
tb_cancelled
tb_exception_declared
tb_exception_cancelled
ic_sent_back
commentary_saved
fields.description: What happened. The audit trail's labels, counts and summary key on it.

fields.label: Entity
fields.description: The entity, for trial balance and TB Exception events. Not a link: an audit row never follows or blocks an entity rename or delete.

fields.label: Reference DocType
fields.description: The type of the document acted on. Given together with Reference Name, or neither.

fields.label: Reference Name
fields.description: The document acted on, by the name it had. Not a link: a rename never edits an audit row.

fields.label: Actor
fields.description: The user id that acted, as it was at the time.

fields.label: At
fields.description: When the action happened. Set by the writer.

fields.label: Reason
fields.description: The typed reason, note, acknowledgement or override reason.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: live: written when the action happened. backfill: recovered from existing records by the backfill patch (konsol#305 T06b).

name: Close Event
